:::{.panel-tabset .full-width }

```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
DT <- RMwTable
if ("siteID" %in% names(DT) && exists("siteID.target", inherits = FALSE)) {
  DT <- DT[siteID %in% siteID.target]
}
if ("ID" %in% names(DT)) {
  ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
    DT,
    "RMw2D.qmd",
    target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
    siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target"),
    base = TRUE
  )
  DT <- DT[ID %in% ID.target]
}
# Display set matches the previous slide: TR >= 500 (shorter TRs exist
# in the data but were never shown).
.TRS <- sort(unique(DT$TR))
.TRS <- .TRS[.TRS >= 500]
.TNS <- sort(unique(DT$Tn))
.SITE <- .currentTarget("siteID.target")
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(.SITE, "siteID.target", "RMw2D caption")
.CONTEXT <- .currentReportContext()
.REPORT <- !is.null(.CONTEXT)
.MULTIPLE <- if (.REPORT) {
  .CONTEXT$multiple
} else {
  is.character(.SITE) && length(.SITE) == 1L
}
.KEY <- if (.REPORT) .CONTEXT$key else tolower(.SITE)
.STEM <- if (.MULTIPLE) paste0(.KEY, "-") else ""
for (.tr in .TRS) {
  cat("\n### $", prettyNum(round(.tr, 0), big.mark = ","), "$\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(":::{.panel-tabset .full-width}\n")
  for (.tn in .TNS) {
    cat("\n#### ", if (.tn == 0) "$T_n=0$ (PGA)" else sprintf("$%.2f\\,s$", .tn), "\n\n", sep = "")
    NGR::knitBlock(
      path = "/_fig/RMw2D_cell.qmd",
      stem = paste0(.STEM, sprintf("rmw2d-tr%s-tn%s", round(.tr), gsub("[.]", "p", .tn))),
      labels = "rewrite",
      vars = list(TR.target = .tr, Tn.target = .tn),
      root = root
    )
  }
  cat("\n:::\n")
}
rm(list = intersect(c(
  "DT", ".TRS", ".TNS", ".SITE", ".CONTEXT", ".REPORT", ".MULTIPLE", ".KEY", ".STEM", ".tr", ".tn", "SiteID.caption"
), ls()))
rm(list = intersect("ID.target", ls()))
rm(list = intersect("CAP", ls()))
```
